title: Ostomy Supply Program Refill Shipment Standard
content:
An Ostomy Supply Program refill ships only while the program is active; a program in referral received, pending authorization, on hold or closed receives no refill.

## A. Authorization and quantity

A.1 Each refill draws on one authorization grant of the program, recorded on the shipment, and the ship date must be on or before the valid-through date on the authorization being drawn.

A.2 The units shipped may not exceed the program's authorized units remaining.

A.3 *Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* "the supply days of a shipment are the tier's supply days per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain." It is superseded by the current basis: for a convex-barrier (A4407) refill, and only for such a refill, the supply days are set as the Ostomy Supply Program's convex-barrier refill rule states; every other refill keeps the supply days of a shipment as the tier's supply days per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain.

A.4 The units and pieces follow from the supply days under the program's item quantity limits.

## B. Customer confirmation and reminders

B.1 *Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* "On tiers where refill confirmation is required, the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand." It is superseded by the current basis: for a convex-barrier (A4407) refill, and only for such a refill, on tiers where refill confirmation is required the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms to the representative, for this shipment and for the enrollment the representative names to them, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand; every other refill on those tiers ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand.

B.2 The confirmation date is recorded on the shipment, Larkfield never ships those tiers automatically, and Larkfield's own refill reminder for those tiers is made no sooner than the tier's reminder lead in calendar days before the planned ship date.

B.3 On the self-pay tier refills ship on the subscription schedule without a per-shipment confirmation.

## C. Earliest ship date

C.1 The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than the tier's ship lead in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item, counted in calendar days: the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply, the earliest permitted ship date is the ship lead in calendar days before that end date, and shipping on that earliest date is allowed. Put another way, the earliest permitted ship date falls the previous refill's supply days less the ship lead after the previous refill's ship date.

C.2 A replacement shipment never counts as the previous refill.

| Hypothetical case: previous refill shipped on day 0 with 30 supply days, ship lead 7 days | Result |
|---|---|
| End of supply | Day 30 |
| Next refill on day 22 | Too early |
| Next refill on day 23 | Allowed - the earliest permitted date |

## D. Coverage verification

D.1 The coverage record the program bills must have been verified with the payer within the tier's coverage re-verification months before the ship date, as shown by the coverage record's last verified date; the self-pay tier has no coverage to verify.

*Hypothetical illustration:* with a 6-month re-verification, a refill shipping on 15 September may ship on a coverage record last verified on 15 March of the same year, but not on one last verified on 14 March.

## E. Shipping charges and billing

E.1 Standard ground shipping is free on insured tiers; on the self-pay tier standard shipping costs the tier's standard shipping fee, posted as a patient charge, unless the shipment's cash-price total reaches the free-shipping threshold.

E.2 *Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* "Expedited shipping is provided on the customer's request for the expedited shipping fee, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed." It is superseded by the current basis: for the expedited shipping charge for a refill a program shipped expedited at the customer's own request, and only for such a charge, the amount is set as the Ostomy Supply Program's expedited shipping charge rule states; every other expedite is provided on the customer's request for the expedited shipping fee, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed.

E.3 An expedite is recorded as expedited at no charge when the expedite only makes up for a delay Larkfield caused.

E.4 A refill on a payer tier is billed to the payer by claim with the ship date as the date of service; a refill on the self-pay tier is charged to the customer at the Larkfield cash price.

## F. Inpatient stays

F.1 On tiers where an inpatient hold is required, nothing ships while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility; the program is held under the program's hold and closure rules.
